## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Vatican City, Vatican. It starts at 9,Via di Villa Giulia.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Imagine the excitement at the excavation sites when they first uncovered these Etruscan and pre-Roman treasures! Skip the line to the National Etruscan Museum of Villa Giulia and wander among artifacts that originated in actual burial tombs. This museum is in Pope Julius III's country retreat, and full of fascinating statues, frescoes, and more.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €20.94. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 150 ratings and 108 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
